primitives.name: Event Schema Verification
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Desired Behavior Minimum page, upgrade, promotion, support, and brief events have schemas and smoke tests.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S': 'Schema set, dimensionless', 'T': 'Test set, dimensionless', 'R': 'Route set, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Each route R has associated schema S and test T; all are verified locally.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When |S ∩ T| < |S|, event schema is incomplete.

layer2.mapping: Schema verification is isomorphic to route-state transition in GSE, where each route r ∈ R maps to a tuple (S_r, T_r) under local data constraints.
layer2.telemetry: Smoke test pass/fail ratio per route

primitives.name: Route State Machine
primitives.verbatim_quote: - parent_id: BUILD-CMD-045 - dependency_ids: BUILD-REALAPP-002 ## Category analytics ## Goal Minimum page, upgrade, promotion, support, and brief events have schemas and smoke tests.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Q': 'State queue, dimensionless', 'δ': 'Transition function, dimensionless', 'r': 'Route identifier, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Each route r has a defined state transition δ(Q_r → Q_{r+1}) based on schema and test compliance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When δ fails due to missing schema, system enters error state.

layer2.mapping: Route state transitions derive from event schema verification kernel, where compliance ensures valid state evolution.
layer2.telemetry: Route entry/exit timestamps and compliance flags

primitives.name: Local Data Boundary
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Data Boundary Use test/local data only unless owner provides approved launch database access.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D_l': 'Local data domain, dimensionless', 'D_a': 'Approved access domain, dimensionless', 'L': 'Leakage indicator, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Data leakage L = 0 when D_l ⊂ D_a; otherwise L > 0.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If D_l ∩ D_a ≠ ∅ and L > 0, boundary violation occurs.

layer2.mapping: Local data boundary is isomorphic to GSI's data integrity constraint, ensuring D_l ⊆ D_a for valid inference.
layer2.telemetry: Data access logs and leakage detection metrics
